public.title: Product customization `/pieces/[slug]/customize`

public.idea: Write plain step guidance without changing schema labels or business facts. Explain which fields are required and what a reference image is used for.

public.accept: Initial load remains at heading; Next/error moves focus deliberately. Back retains answers. Retry does not create duplicate requests; private references stay private.

public.title: Commission entry `/commission`
public.heading: An idea is enough to begin.
sections: choose an existing piece or bespoke path
public.idea: Help someone decide between adapting an existing design and describing a new brief. Suggested prompts cover purpose, room, approximate scale and reference preferences.
public.visual: A split chapter uses the material-detail asset. Two equal decision cards have concise descriptions and a visible destination.
public.accept: Both paths are keyboard accessible. Links preserve the intended product or bespoke context. No deposit, price or deadline is fabricated.

public.title: Bespoke request `/commission/customize`
public.heading: Tell us where your piece begins.
public.idea: Use examples as optional prompts, never as prefilled answers. Let people say what is undecided. Keep existing required fields and consent wording.
public.visual: One calm reading column plus a summary on wide screens; numbered steps and visible errors. Use a small reviewed editorial detail only in the intro.
public.accept: No initial autofocus jump. All failures retain entered values. Upload retry, schema-change review and manual-send semantics remain unchanged.

public.title: Saved-request receipt `/inquiry/received`
public.heading: Your brief is saved.
public.idea: Separate request saved, message prepared and customer chooses to send. Never say the message was sent or an order confirmed without supporting evidence.
public.visual: Quiet confirmation panel, readable reference number, two clearly separated actions. No confetti or completion percentage.
public.accept: Reload is safe; private receipt tokens never appear in screenshots or reports. Copy failure offers selectable text. Message preparation failure leaves the saved brief recoverable.

public.title: Atelier story `/our-story`; alias `/about`
public.heading: The personal part gives it direction.
public.idea: Use approved origin/founder/business facts only. Suggested editorial angle: how a room or memory informs a brief. Keep detailed chapter structure.
public.visual: Alternate generous image/text spreads. Label maker-hands as an illustrative scene, not a photograph of Rivya staff. Genuine portrait remains conditional.
public.accept: Each chapter can be edited, previewed and recovered. Missing proof removes the proof module instead of leaving fabricated staff or awards.

public.title: Process `/process`
public.heading: Considered together. Made personal.
public.idea: Describe the actual customer workflow. Separate illustrative making footage from customer steps; do not imply every depicted workshop action is verified Rivya practice.
public.visual: Four numbered chapters with a desktop progress rail and visible captions. Optional user-played detail clip later; static images remain default.
public.accept: All four steps readable without animation. Reduced motion uses a simple vertical list. Sticky imagery must release before the footer and never cover text.

public.title: Materials and care `/materials-care`; aliases `/materials`, `/care`
public.heading: Material, movement, meaning.
public.idea: Content ideas: how to describe a finish preference and what to ask about intended use. Preserve approved care instructions and avoid unsupported heat/water claims.
public.visual: Macro edge-detail beside typography. Separate care instructions with clear headings; no abstract video behind instructions.
public.accept: Material and care anchors resolve from other pages. Advice is sourced to reviewed content. Tables reflow; print view remains legible.

public.title: Architects and collaborators `/architects`
public.heading: Think about the space around it.
public.idea: Address architects through useful brief questions: use, approximate footprint, surrounding finishes, city and access constraints. Do not invent trade discounts or completed commissions.
public.visual: Collectible doorway plus a detail image; simple annotated spatial diagrams labelled illustrative. Project photography only when genuine evidence exists.
public.accept: Architect CTA reaches the correct brief. No unsupported BIM/download/trade program is activated. Visual diagrams have text equivalents.

public.title: Journey aliases `/preserve`, `/personalize`
public.heading: Choose the story you want to tell.
public.idea: Keep aliases useful and exact; avoid a thin duplicate page with conflicting promises. Preserve reviewed old-URL disposition and language selection.
public.visual: Reuse the relevant memory or personal-art collection treatment rather than another generic River Channel hero.
public.accept: Alias behavior and canonical destination agree with the registry; unsupported legacy product identities do not guess a replacement.

public.title: Portfolio index `/portfolio`
public.heading: Spaces with a story.
sections: genuine project index or honest empty state
public.idea: Only feature substantiated projects with permission. While empty, explain the work-in-progress collection and link to design explorations clearly labelled as such.
public.visual: A future project grid uses wide contextual images and short factual metadata. Today, use a restrained text-led empty state, not fake installations.
public.accept: No invented clients, project locations or completion years. Empty state is accessible; unapproved detail records remain unavailable.

public.title: Project detail `/portfolio/[slug]`
public.heading: A project, considered in detail.
public.idea: Conditional template. Collect consent, approved location granularity, dates and actual photographs before publication. Quotes require attribution and permission.

public.accept: Unknown project slugs return 404. Publication requires real evidence and image permission; title, gallery and credits are versioned.

public.title: Journal index `/journal`

public.visual: ADM-inspired editorial grid with varied emphasis but stable card reading order. Distinct approved images for categories. Actual titles and dates remain unchanged.

public.title: Journal article `/journal/[slug]`

public.accept: Headings, anchors and captions work at 200% zoom. Publish/restore changes article version safely. Related links resolve public records only.

public.title: Frequently asked questions `/faq`
public.heading: Your questions, considered.

public.accept: Keyboard activation and state announcement work. Deep-linked question opens correctly. FAQ does not contradict protected policies or contact settings.

studio.title: Studio overview
studio.design: Bionis metric-card hierarchy; Medesk recent-record table and truthful stage bars; Gridline searchable workspaces.
studio.contract: Actual permitted task counts, updated IST timestamp, exact inquiry links, saved publication checks and recent editorial revisions. Never infer revenue, conversion or WhatsApp delivery.
studio.status: Local implementation; verify empty/loading/error/stale and role scope.

studio.title: Inquiries & orders
studio.design: Dense but readable table, filter bar and persistent applied chips; optional board with clear stage labels.
studio.contract: Keep mode/filter/sort/page/record in URL. Drawer groups summary, brief, references, notes, task, amendments and audit. Stage changes retain reason and stale-version handling.
studio.status: Proposed visual extension of existing working flow; no customer mutation in this visual pass.

studio.title: Follow-ups due
studio.design: Medesk-inspired agenda/table with Today, Overdue, Upcoming views and a compact task rail.
studio.contract: Use IST date-only presets, assigned scope, explicit save and clear next action. Keep exact record navigation and preserve date values.
studio.status: Existing feature; visual extension proposed. Test IST midnight and month boundary.

studio.title: Catalogue & forms
studio.design: Gridline-style catalogue workspace, clear publication labels and a protected-record banner.
studio.contract: Existing products stay in review by default. Preview real form schema, compare revisions, review exact galleries. New-product media association remains a separately deferred dependency.
studio.status: Protected; no import, creation, product transfer, scraper work or schema mutation.

studio.title: Pages & journal
studio.design: Wide chapter editor with a collapsible section outline, readable content controls and sticky save/preview/publish bar.
studio.contract: Expose record ID, saved version, dirty state, draft/published/hidden state, readiness and exact preview. Drag interactions always have move-up/down alternatives. Section templates keep detailed old-site storytelling.
studio.status: Existing P2/P4 contract retained; visual refinement proposed. Full saved-preview/publish/restore cycle required after expansion.

studio.title: Site copy
studio.design: Searchable label groups with usage locations, original value context and compact language tabs.
studio.contract: Show exact record/field links and distinguish global copy from a single page override. Social content and protected business fields remain unchanged.
studio.status: Proposed refinement. Blank and untranslated values cannot silently replace published text.

studio.title: Public media
studio.design: Consistent thumbnail grid, visible selection border and inspector with provenance, description, crops and usage.
studio.contract: Keep approved public assets separate from private inquiry references. Stable card height prevents the previous overlapping-thumbnail regression. Show usage before publication/hiding.
studio.status: Existing regression fix preserved. Recheck two-column narrow inspector and keyboard selection.

studio.title: Site images
studio.design: Page-first slot navigator with desktop/mobile crop tabs and paired preview frames.
studio.contract: Select a real approved media identity; store focal points/ratios per usage; show missing/unpublished states. Existing product galleries are outside this assignment editor.
studio.status: Proposed visual refinement; P3 crop and version contracts retained.

studio.title: Content health
studio.design: Action-oriented health dashboard with blocker/warning tabs, exact field repair links and saved-read timestamp.
studio.contract: Readiness is computed from saved records, not an invented score. Retain old results on refresh failure. A fix link opens the exact record, tab and field.
studio.status: Existing functional route and links preserved; visual refinement proposed.

studio.title: Language review
studio.design: Coverage table by record/language with complete-record review, fallback badge and side-by-side copy.
studio.contract: English/Hindi/Gujarati priority. Machine drafts are not reviewed language content. Preserve source revision checks, exact previews and factual terms.
studio.status: Existing P6 behavior; long text, script layout and source-change checks remain in acceptance.

studio.title: Navigation & languages
studio.design: Grouped navigation rows with destination status, reorder controls and preview context.
studio.contract: Only admitted routes may be selected; keyboard reorder alternative. Preserve active language choices and external-social destinations exactly.
studio.status: Admin-only guard unchanged. Visual extension proposed; no new locale or route activation.

studio.title: Legacy decisions
studio.design: Decision table with old route, disposition, evidence, current destination and review state.
studio.contract: Keep/adapt/retire/conditional decisions remain explicit. Do not guess product mappings, migrate products or re-enable unsupported services.
studio.status: Existing P6 rules retained; proposed evidence-led table refinement.

studio.title: Old links & publication
studio.design: Publication/readiness matrix and redirect diagnostics, linked to exact records.
studio.contract: Separate route registered, content published, verified redirect and indexable state. Show unknown destinations without creating fake equivalence.
studio.status: Existing admin tool; no index activation. Direct unauthenticated requests must stay denied.

studio.title: Activity & logs
studio.design: Readable revision timeline, filter chips and side-by-side or inline field diff.
studio.contract: Actor, time, entity and action remain immutable evidence. Restore produces a new draft and retains audit history; conflicts preserve unsaved edits.
studio.status: Existing recovery semantics preserved; visual refinement proposed.

studio.title: Staff access
studio.design: Simple staff table and explicit review panel for role, activation and session effects.
studio.contract: Keep least-privilege server checks, pending/success/error/409 states and real revocation behavior. Do not add invite mail or access grants to mimic a demo.
studio.status: Admin-only. No staff changes made in this design pass.

studio.title: Atelier settings
studio.design: Well-separated protected business facts, operational controls and recovery evidence cards.
studio.contract: Phone, email, socials, legal facts and scraper settings stay unchanged. Recovery and backup statuses distinguish last success, age, interval and offsite custody.
studio.status: Protected read-only review. Independent key copies and sustained backup history remain unverified.
